_comment: The one declaration of the application's file and bundle names, its service labels and the external hosts the drivers talk to. tools/codegen/codegen-identifiers.cjs emits _shared/lua/identifiers.lua from it; Node tools read this file directly. tools/test/test-repo-url-single-source.cjs holds every other driver source to a shrinking baseline of typed copies. The GitHub owner and repository stay in _shared/modules/updater/defaults.json.
